skill.name: competitor-tracker
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "track competitor influencer marketing", "see who my rivals partner with", or "benchmark my influencer program"; produces a competitor partnership roster, campaign and content-strategy breakdown, performance estimates, and a gap/opportunity list. Not for finding your own new creators — use influencer-discovery.
skill.summary: Track competitor influencer partnerships, campaign patterns, and opportunity gaps.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: No prompt-injection or data-exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md or references/templates.md. Most static findings are Markdown links, code fences, connector placeholders, or public documentation URLs. The only confirmed risks are optional shell commands in SKILL.md lines 59 and 61, which should require user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands are embedded directly in SKILL.md.
remediation.suggestion: Mark the gdelt.py, youtube.py, and rss_monitor.py examples as manual-only, and require user confirmation before any connector command runs.

remediation.issue: The YouTube connector note mentions an API key without secret-handling guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short note that API keys must stay local, should not be pasted into prompts, and must not be logged in reports.

content.value_statement: Competitor influencer programs can be hard to compare when partnership data, campaign patterns, and estimated performance are scattered. This skill turns public signals and approved connector data into a structured benchmark, opportunity list, and planning handoff.
actual_capabilities: Builds a current or recent competitor creator roster with handle, platform, followers, partnership type, and duration.
Breaks down competitor campaigns by timeline, platform, creator tier mix, content type, hashtag, CTA, and estimated spend.
Reviews content strategy across themes, messaging, hashtag use, visual style, tone, and creative direction.
Estimates reach, engagement, EMV, spend, and performance by platform and creator tier when data is available.
Produces side-by-side comparisons, share-of-voice summaries, and ranked opportunity lists.
Creates handoff recommendations for campaign planning, influencer discovery, or fit scoring.
limitations: Requires competitor names, platforms, time period, and available public or user-supplied data.
Performance, spend, and EMV figures are estimates unless verified source data is supplied.
Connector placeholders require host-approved integrations or local scripts before live data can be pulled.
Does not replace legal review for competitive intelligence practices or platform terms.

use_cases.title: Benchmark Rival Programs
use_cases.description: Compare competitor partner rosters, campaign cadence, content formats, and estimated performance before planning the next campaign.

use_cases.title: Find Creator Gaps
use_cases.description: Identify untapped creators, former competitor partners, and open platform niches that could support a differentiated outreach plan.

use_cases.title: Prepare Competitive Intelligence
use_cases.description: Create an executive report with key findings, threats to monitor, immediate actions, and the next review date.

prompt_templates.title: Track One Competitor
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start with one brand and one platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Track [competitor] influencer marketing on [platform] for the last [time period]. List current partners, campaign themes, content formats, and estimated performance.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Rivals
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare multiple competitors in one category.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare influencer strategies for [competitor 1], [competitor 2], and [competitor 3] in [category]. Include partner rosters, tier mix, campaign cadence, and content themes.

prompt_templates.title: Find Missed Opportunities
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: turn the benchmark into an action list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze where [competitors] are underusing creators, platforms, formats, or niches. Rank at least five opportunities for [my brand] with evidence and priority.

prompt_templates.title: Build Quarterly Tracking Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: create a repeatable intelligence workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a quarterly competitor influencer tracking plan for [my brand]. Define competitors, platforms, data fields, review cadence, estimated metrics, reporting format, and next-skill handoff.

output_examples.input: Track Glossier, Fenty Beauty, and Rare Beauty on TikTok and Instagram for the last quarter.
output_examples.output: A competitive intelligence report with partner rosters, campaign summaries, content themes, estimated reach, share-of-voice comparison, and ranked opportunities.

output_examples.input: Find influencer opportunities my competitors are missing in clean beauty.
output_examples.output: A prioritized opportunity list covering untapped creators, former competitor partners, low-competition platforms, niche gaps, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Benchmark our influencer program against three rivals before campaign planning.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison of partner count, primary tier, main platform, spend estimate, engagement estimate, content style, and relationship model.

best_practices: Provide the competitor set, category, platforms, time period, and known creator handles before analysis starts.
Label all reach, spend, EMV, and engagement figures as estimates unless verified data is supplied.
Use the final opportunity list as input for campaign planning, influencer discovery, or fit scoring.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated competitor performance as verified financial or sales data.
Do not use the skill to access private accounts, bypass platform limits, or collect nonpublic personal data.
Do not skip source notes when reporting competitor partnerships or campaign claims.

faq.question: What does this skill track?
faq.answer: It tracks competitor creator partnerships, campaign patterns, content strategy, estimated performance, and opportunity gaps.

faq.question: Can it find new creators for my brand?
faq.answer: It can surface untapped or former competitor partners, but dedicated creator discovery belongs in the influencer-discovery skill.

faq.question: Does it need live platform integrations?
faq.answer: No. It works with user-supplied and public information, while connector placeholders can improve speed when available.

faq.question: Are spend and performance numbers exact?
faq.answer: No. The skill treats spend, reach, engagement, and EMV as estimates unless verified data is provided.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.

faq.question: What should I do after the report?
faq.answer: Use campaign-planner for strategy, influencer-discovery for open creator gaps, or fit-scorer to evaluate competitor partners.
